## Documentation

The source of a rich message to send, used in [`InputRichMessage`](InputRichMessage.md).

It can be one of:

- [`RichMessageSourceBlocks`](RichMessageSourceBlocks.md)
- [`RichMessageSourceMarkdown`](RichMessageSourceMarkdown.md)
